text:
Rachael (Sales): Polaris requires the POC to guarantee regional processing: EU users processed in eu-west, APAC in asia-southeast. They also want keys resident in-region (HSM/BYOK) and a simple sub-processor inventory per region. Are there any production blockers we should flag before we quote?

Omar (SE): We can do tenant routing by geo and pin tenants to region for the POC. BYOK into cloud KMS is supported; HSM import depends on provider and may add extra validation time. Sub-processor inventory is straightforward for EU/APAC edge components but note some control-plane metadata (billing IDs, job IDs) currently land in our central control plane unless we route audit logs to customer buckets.

Client_Polaris: Critical question: will any async background work (embeddings index, batch evals, model telemetry) touch data outside pinned region? They want a yes/no and a mitigation plan.

Omar (SE): For the POC we will disable scheduled background exports by default. Embeddings indexing can be scoped to the same region if we provision regional index workers for the tenant. That is an ops change but doable for POC. Telemetry ingest (metrics/usage) can be configured to redact IPs and sensitive headers or routed to a customer-managed endpoint in-region.

Nina (Compliance): Please provide per-region sub-processor names+roles (EU, APAC). Also need acknowledgement about what metadata fields we classify as PII for the customer's policy (we consider ip_address, request_headers, and user-provided PII fields). We will need a signed POC attestation: "No PII-bearing logs/backups will be exported off the tenant's pinned region for the POC period."

Leo (Infra): Ops notes: Steps to satisfy Polaris for a 14-day POC: 1) create tenant routing entry and pin to region, 2) provision region-scoped KMS (BYOK import or platform key), 3) create a log sink to the customer's in-region bucket for control-plane audit logs, 4) disable cross-region backups/analytics for that tenant, 5) spin up regional index workers if embeddings indexing is required. Estimated hands-on time: 6-24 hours (BYOK import typical; HSM import + escrow 24-48h). Constraint: if Polaris requires that no sub-processor outside the region has any access (including managed metrics agents), that is a blocker because some managed services replicate small metadata to our central control plane.

Rachael (Sales): Pricing asks: Polaris wants a compact POC quote with line items for setup, per-region KMS handling, and any surcharge for regional isolation. They also asked whether SLA changes if we pin regionally.

Omar (SE): Internal ballpark for a 14-day POC: 
- One-time setup (routing, sink, config): $650
- BYOK/HSM handling: $140 one-time (HSM import may be extra $200 for escrow/validation)
- Key mgmt surcharge: $70/month per region (pro-rated for POC)
- Regional index workers (if needed): small reserved capacity, estimate $120 for POC period
- SLA: POC uses normal hosted SLA; production multi-region availability requires reserved capacity & separate SLA.

(We can mark analytics isolation work as waived for POC but bill for any large-scale reserved capacity.)

Client_Polaris: Can you show the exact API we toggle for tenant pinning and how we query the effective region? Also need the sub-processor list before EOD to present to their legal.

Omar (SE): API example (curl):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/polaris/pin \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region":"europe-west1","kms_key":"projects/polaris/locations/europe-west1/keys/pol-key"}'

Query route:
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/polaris/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"

And note: to route control-plane logs to customer bucket we create a sink job that writes to s3://polaris-redwood-logs-eu with a temporary write role.

Ops-bot: Job queued: tenant-pin-2412345678. Requires infra + compliance approvals.

Leo (Infra): I'll DM the full per-region sub-processor list to Nina (Compliance) and post a summarized non-sensitive list here: cloud-provider compute+networking, managed KMS, metrics agent, and our delivery job for log sink. If Polaris requires absolute in-region physical-only sub-processors, that's a legal blocker; please flag.

Nina (Compliance): Once I receive the sub-processor list I'll draft the POC attestation and ask security to sign off. Also: confirm whether control-plane billing identifiers are considered PII by Polaris; if so we'll route billing metadata to their bucket as part of the sink.

Rachael (Sales): I'll send Polaris the POC quote and the API snippet now and ask for BYOK material if they want HSM import. @leo_infra please update this thread when approvals are in. :thumbsup:

Client_Polaris: Thanks team. If we get the sub-processor list + attestation by EOD tomorrow we can keep the planned kickoff next week.
